description.en: {count} public projects by Ted Huang: AI workflows, agent operations, security, creative tools and home automation. English and Traditional Chinese introductions with current project status.
description.zh: Ted Huang 的 {count} 個公開專案：多 AI 工作流程、agent 維運、資安、創作工具與家庭自動化。中英雙語介紹，依各專案目前進度更新。

lede.en: {count} public projects: AI workflows, desktop memory, agent operations, security, creative tools and a home assistant. Each project has its own introduction, current scope and next step.
lede.zh: {count} 個公開專案：多 AI 工作流程、桌面記憶、agent 維運、資安、創作工具與家庭管家。每個專案都有自己的介紹、目前能做的事與開始方式。

label.en: years in enterprise IT and security
label.zh: 年企業 IT 與資安經驗

title.en: AI that works where you already work.
title.zh: 在你熟悉的工具裡用 AI。

intro.en: Use several AI services together, recall your own work, prepare a recap with sources, or run creative workflows on your computer.
intro.zh: 一起使用多個 AI 服務、找回自己的工作記憶、整理有來源的回顧，或在自己的電腦上執行創作工作流。

summary.en: Chat, memory, research and creative work

line.en: A desktop workspace for four signed-in AI services, with guided reviews, saved checkpoints and replay. Stable v1.9.6; features are frozen while compatibility is maintained.
line.zh: 把四個已登入的 AI 服務放在同一個桌面工作空間，支援引導式審查、檢查點與重播。正式版 v1.9.6，功能已凍結，持續維護相容性。

line.en: A Chrome side panel for four AI services, with v0.4.0 workflow recovery after restart. GitHub has v0.4.0; the Chrome Web Store currently offers v0.3.0.
line.zh: 在 Chrome 側邊面板協調四個 AI 服務，v0.4.0 可在重啟後接續工作流程。GitHub 提供 v0.4.0，Chrome 商店目前為 v0.3.0。

line.en: A local workbench that runs staged multi-agent coding workflows on the headless runtimes of Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and Antigravity, with gates and a replayable evidence feed.
line.zh: 本機工作台，在 Claude Code、Codex、Grok、Antigravity 的 headless runtime 上跑分階段的多 agent 工作流程，有關卡，也有可重播的證據紀錄。

line.en: A desktop memory companion with local recording, OCR and answers linked to their sources. Alpha.171 offers Windows and Ubuntu X11 downloads; macOS delivery is still pending.
line.zh: 桌面記憶夥伴，在本機記錄、辨識畫面文字，回答可點回來源。Alpha.171 提供 Windows 與 Ubuntu X11 下載，macOS 仍待交付。

line.en: A small web app for idea review: pick 5, 12, or 16 rounds, leave, and come back to a Markdown report by link or email.
line.zh: 點子審查的小型網頁 app：選 5、12 或 16 輪，先離開，之後用連結或 email 拿到 Markdown 報告。

line.en: A Claude Code skill that puts an idea through a 5, 12, or 16-round review panel before you spend time building it.
line.zh: Claude Code skill：在你花時間動手之前，先讓點子經過 5、12 或 16 輪的審查。

line.en: Keep comments, transcripts and cited drafts together on your computer. The 0.1.0a2 alpha supports local import, text search and exports, with optional connected workflows.
line.zh: 在自己的電腦上保存留言、字幕與附來源的草稿。0.1.0a2 alpha 支援本機匯入、文字搜尋與匯出，也可另行設定帳號連線。

line.en: A local ComfyUI front end for image, video and voice workflows, queues and media collections. Explore 23 tools in the static demo; generation runs on your own installation.
line.zh: ComfyUI 的本機操作介面，整合圖片、影片、語音工作流、佇列與素材庫。靜態展示可探索 23 種工具，實際生成在自己的安裝環境執行。

title.en: Agent work, with context and control.
title.zh: 讓 agent 工作有脈絡，也有界線。

intro.en: Manage agent work and decisions, connect local tools, retain memory, track usage, and bring supervised automation into the home.
intro.zh: 管理 agent 工作與決策、串接本機工具、保存記憶、追蹤用量，並把需要人批准的自動化帶進家庭。

summary.en: Project work, connectors and home automation
summary.zh: 專案協作、連接器與家庭自動化

line.en: A shared Web and desktop workspace for project progress, PM discussions, requirements and agent work. Published development previews include a demo with synthetic data.
line.zh: Web 與桌面共用的專案工作空間，整理進度、PM 討論、需求與 agent 工作。已有開發預覽版，並提供使用合成資料的互動展示。

line.en: A server-first cowork workstation: a Paseo-derived daemon with a Better Agent Terminal desktop client. Work in progress, not a release.
line.zh: 伺服器優先的協作工作站：Paseo 衍生的 daemon，加上 Better Agent Terminal 桌面端。仍在開發中，尚未發布。

line.en: Tracks Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Grok Build token use on your own machine, with a live dashboard and companions that grow with real milestones.
line.zh: 在你自己的電腦上追蹤 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 的 token 用量，有即時儀表板，陪伴角色會隨真實里程碑成長。

line.en: A guarded evolution layer for OpenClaw hosts: Hermes studies and proposes, a Bash watcher guards, and the operator approves.
line.zh: OpenClaw 主機的守護型演化層：Hermes 研究並提案，Bash watcher 把關，由操作者核准。

line.en: A curated operating layer for Claude Code: reviewed specs, persistent memory, reusable skills, and workspaces that follow you across machines.
line.zh: Claude Code 的精選運作層：經過審閱的規格、持久記憶、可重用的 skill，以及跨機器延續的工作區。

line.en: An MCP server for long-term agent memory: decisions, resolved issues, open questions, and knowledge that you can inspect.
line.zh: 給 agent 用的長期記憶 MCP 伺服器：決策、已解決的問題、待回答的問題與知識，都可以檢視。

line.en: A Linux home server with Home Assistant, an AI butler and isolated development helpers. v0.11.0 is an installation preview; v0.11.1 remains a candidate under validation.
line.zh: 把 Home Assistant、AI 家庭管家與隔離的開發助手放在同一台 Linux 主機。v0.11.0 是試裝預覽，v0.11.1 仍是驗證中的候選版。

line.en: A local OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint backed by the Antigravity CLI, with account selection and quota cooldowns. A source-only utility using Python standard-library code.
line.zh: 以 Antigravity CLI 提供本機 OpenAI 相容聊天端點，支援帳號選擇與配額冷卻。使用 Python 標準函式庫，目前以原始碼提供。

title.en: Twenty years of IT, turned into tools.
title.zh: 二十年 IT 經驗，做成工具。

intro.en: Security checks, machine control, AI governance, and awareness training that come from running real company systems.
intro.zh: 從實際維運公司系統累積出來的資安檢查、機器管控、AI 治理與資安意識教材。

summary.en: Scanner, control plane, AI governance, training
summary.zh: 掃描、控制平面、AI 治理、教材

line.en: A desktop security workbench that combines scanner evidence into actionable reports. v0.5.3 adds an incident scan pack; Windows, macOS and Linux installers are available.
line.zh: 把多種掃描工具的證據整理成可採取行動報告的桌面資安工作台。v0.5.3 加入事件掃描包，提供 Windows、macOS 與 Linux 安裝檔。

line.en: A control plane for AI machines: enroll hosts, deploy software profiles, verify jobs and keep evidence. Linux is deployed; macOS and Windows await hardware acceptance.
line.zh: 管理 AI 機器的控制平臺：註冊主機、部署軟體設定、驗證工作並保留證據。Linux 已部署，macOS 與 Windows 仍待實機驗收。

line.en: Self-hosted AI chat with model access by group, prompt and response checks, budget reservations, audit exports and retention controls. Bring your own provider credentials.
line.zh: 自架 AI 聊天系統，依群組管理模型權限，檢查提示詞與回覆，並提供預算保留、稽核匯出與資料保留控制。使用自己的供應商憑證。

line.en: A one-page bilingual awareness demo that shows how a look-alike Unicode domain can pass for the real one.
line.zh: 一頁式的中英雙語資安意識示範：看看長得一模一樣的 Unicode 網域，怎麼冒充真的網站。

title.en: Not everything needs to be a platform.
title.zh: 不是每樣東西都要做成平台。

intro.en: A parody toy, a strategy notebook, and a helper repository for a community bot.
intro.zh: 一個惡搞小玩具、一本策略筆記，還有一個替社群機器人存圖的倉庫。

line.en: A bilingual anti-burnout toy: watch four fake AI quota panels burn down, then let golden dragons reset them.
line.zh: 中英雙語的抗倦怠小玩具：看著四個假的 AI 額度面板燒光，再讓黃金龍幫你重置。

line.en: Chinese-first notes on Beyblade X: why points, not spin time, decide a match, and how to build a 3v3 deck.
line.zh: 戰鬥陀螺 Beyblade X 中文筆記：為什麼決定勝負的是分數而不是誰轉得最久，以及怎麼配 3v3 牌組。

line.en: Image storage for the GitHub issues that the 自由工坊 community bot files from Discord, because Discord attachment links expire.
line.zh: 自由工坊社群機器人從 Discord 開 GitHub issue 時用的圖片倉庫，因為 Discord 附件連結會過期。

body.en: I studied computer science at National Central University in Taiwan, then spent nearly two decades in the United States running identity, endpoints, ERP, BI, CRM, and security programs inside real businesses.
body.zh: 我在台灣讀中央大學資工，之後在美國將近二十年，在真實的企業裡負責身分管理、端點、ERP、BI、CRM 與資安計畫。

body.en: I build AI agent tooling with the same habits: people keep the final say, state survives a restart, and every claim leaves evidence.
body.zh: 現在我用同樣的習慣做 AI agent 工具：最後的決定權留在人手上，狀態重開也不會遺失，每個說法都留下證據。

quote.en: Working for months in a real environment matters more than looking clever in a demo.
quote.zh: demo 裡看起來聰明，不如在真實環境裡穩定跑上好幾個月。

heading.en: From MUD wizard to AI agents
heading.zh: 從 MUD 巫師到 agent

intro.en: Code changes. The ideas don't. The heartbeat I learned about in a MUD is what keeps my agents running today.
intro.zh:
Code 怎麼變，觀念都不會變。
我在 MUD 學到的心跳，現在用在 agent 上。

note.en: I got hooked on a text MUD as a kid and was still playing it in college.
note.zh: 我從小迷上一個文字 MUD，一路玩到大學。

note.en: While I studied computer science at National Central University in Taiwan, I went from player to wizard, coding for that world and keeping its server running.
note.zh:
在中央大學念資工時，我從玩家變成巫師，
幫那個世界寫程式，也顧它的主機。

note.en: Then I spent nearly twenty years at US companies, working on identity, endpoints, ERP, BI, CRM, and security.
note.zh:
之後在美國將近二十年，
在企業裡做身分管理、端點、
ERP、BI、CRM 和資安。

note.en: Long-running agents need a heartbeat too, a steady tick that keeps the work moving.
note.zh:
長時間跑的 agent 也要有心跳，
事情才會一直往前走。

caption.en: I build AI agents with habits I picked up in the MUD and in twenty years of corporate IT. A MUD runs on heart_beat: every mob and NPC has one, and if it stops, poison never kicks in and nobody heals. Long-running agents need the same heartbeat.
caption.zh:
我小時候迷上一個文字 MUD，一路玩到大學。在中央大學念資工時，我從玩家變成巫師，幫那個世界寫程式，也顧它的主機。之後在美國將近二十年，在企業裡做身分管理、端點、ERP、BI、CRM 和資安。現在我用同樣的習慣做 AI agent 工具。heart_beat 是 MUD 最基本的概念，每一個 mob、每一個 NPC 都有心跳，世界靠心跳在流動。心跳沒在跑，毒不會發作，也不會回血。
長時間跑的 agent，也需要同樣的心跳。

intro.en: I start with how a real employee would do the job, and only wake the AI where that person would stop and think.
intro.zh:
先想一個真人員工會怎麼做，
只有他得動腦的地方才叫醒 AI。

note.en: An employee opens the ERP to write up a quote.
note.zh: 員工打開 ERP，要開一張報價單。

note.en: Anything that takes no thinking runs as code: CRUD, search, notifications.
note.zh:
不用動腦的事走 code，
像 CRUD、搜尋、通知。

note.en: The AI only wakes up for a judgment call, like how big a discount this customer gets.
note.zh:
要動腦的才叫醒 AI，
像是這個客戶該給多少折扣。

note.en: In a 10-step process, maybe 8 steps finish there and only 2 wake the AI.
note.zh:
10 步的流程，可能 8 步在資料庫做完，
只有 2 步要叫醒 AI。

ticks.en: maybe 8 of 10 steps are just code

caption.en: Agents should work like that employee: analysis, judgment, and writing go to the model, and everything else is plain code. Designing one comes down to two questions: if this were a company, how would it manage its people, and if it were a person, how would they do the job? Then I turn the answers into code.
caption.zh:
想像一個人類員工。他不會每次打開 ERP 都要想怎麼建報價單，點幾個按鈕就好了，只有在判斷這個客戶該給多少折扣的時候，才需要動腦。Agent 也一樣：動腦的事給 LLM，像分析、判斷、寫作；不動腦的事走 code，像 CRUD、搜尋、通知。一個 10 步的流程，可能 8 步在資料庫完成，只有 2 步需要叫醒 AI。AI Agent 的設計，最終就是在回答兩個問題：
如果這是一間公司，它會怎麼管理員工？如果這是一個人，他會怎麼做這件事？然後把答案寫成 code。

intro.en: The main project gets to its first milestone before anything else. New ideas wait their turn, and optimizing comes after it's done.
intro.zh:
主專案先做到第一個里程碑，
新想法先排隊，做完再來優化。

note.en: New ideas get written down here. No building, no research, no optimizing.
note.zh:
新想法先寫進 Parking Lot，
不做、不研究、不優化。

note.en: Only one at a time, and I stay with it through the boring parts.
note.zh:
一次只做一個，
執行期的無聊也接受。

note.en: No new projects until it gets there.

ticks.en: one main project at a time

caption.en: Until the main project reaches its first milestone, new ideas go into the Parking Lot and stay there. I accept the boring part of execution, and I only optimize what's finished. Every project page here also says what doesn't work yet.
caption.zh:
我一次只做一個主專案。在它做到第一個里程碑之前，新想法只能寫進 Parking Lot，不實作、不研究、不優化。執行期的無聊，我接受。
完成比完美重要，做完了，才有資格優化。
這裡每個專案頁也都寫了還做不到的地方。
